content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Bibinagar
content_sections.text: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bibinagar is a medical institute in the Hyderabad Metropolitan Region of Telangana. This post is in the institute's Department of Orthopaedics, under the ADIDOC project led by Dr. Y. Ranjith Kumar, Principal Investigator and Associate Professor, Department of Orthopaedics. The project works on an advanced carbon fiber foot prosthesis under the Make in India Initiative.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives two alternative routes (either one is enough): Three-year graduate degree in a relevant subject/field (Biomedical / Mechanical / Computer Science / Information Technology / Computer Applications) from a recognized University + two years' experience in relevant subject/field. OR 12th (Science) + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/Engineering or equivalent) + 5 years' experience in relevant subject/field. Candidates must possess the required essential qualifications and experience on or before the last date of application. All educational qualifications/certificates must be from a recognized Board/University. Experience shall be preferably from Government organizations and is counted after the date of completion of the minimum essential qualification; experience from reputed National/International organizations will also be considered, and experience in the relevant field/area, as required for the project, will be considered. Experience in data entry, documentation and MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint); familiarity with Google Workspace and Canva. Experience in research/clinical data collection, participant follow-up, record keeping and file management. Experience in procurement documentation and administrative work in a government/research setting. Basic knowledge of statistics, and basic understanding of AI and automation tools. Good communication and interpersonal skills; ability to communicate effectively in English, Telugu and Hindi will be preferred. The upper age limit is 35 years as on the date of the interview. The notice's vacancy table heads this column "as on 11th December 2026", which is the tentative interview date. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Candidates who are already employed in a regular position under the Central/State Government, Government institutions, or other Government organizations are not eligible to apply for the post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a monthly remuneration of Rs. 20,000/- + HRA, As Admissible, described in the notice as a consolidated fixed salary. The appointment is for the sanctioned period of 18 months, purely on contractual and temporary basis, and is co-terminus with the project. It will automatically come to an end with the completion/termination of the project or expiry of the sanctioned period, whichever is earlier. Any extension will be subject to satisfactory performance, project requirements, continuation of the project, availability of funds, and approval of the competent authority. The appointee will have no claim for regular appointment, permanent employment, or absorption in AIIMS Bibinagar or any other Government organization. These are tenure vacancies under a funded project and are not employment on AIIMS Bibinagar payroll. Leave is admissible as per AIIMS Bibinagar rules for project staff, on a pro-rata basis where applicable; it is not carried forward beyond the contract and unavailed leave is not encashed, unless the applicable rules provide otherwise. The appointment may be terminated by either side by giving one month's notice or one month's remuneration in lieu thereof.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Should support ongoing projects by performing data entry and documentation, conducting data analysis and reporting, and providing overall technical and operational assistance. To maintain project records, files and registers, and to assist in procurement documentation and administrative work of the project. To assist in data analysis, progress reports, utilization-related documentation and other reporting to the funding agency. To undertake any other project-related duties assigned by the Principal Investigator. The selected candidate may also be required to perform field visits, participant follow-up and other activities, as required by the study protocol and directed by the Principal Investigator.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bibinagar Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the AIIMS Bibinagar website ( https://aiimsbibinagar.edu.in/ ). Fill in and sign the application form and affix one passport-size photograph on it. Combine the form with self-attested copies of all relevant certificates/documents (including the experience letter) into a single PDF of maximum 10 MB. Name the file "Name_SPA_ADIDOC.pdf". Email it to [email protected] with the subject: "Application for the Contractual Post of Senior Project Assistant – ADIDOC Project – AIIMS Bibinagar". Make sure the application reaches the e-mail ID on or before 30-11-2026, 5:00 PM. Applications received after the last date and time will not be considered. 10th Class/SSC certificate or equivalent certificate as proof of Date of Birth. All relevant educational qualification certificates and mark sheets from 10th class onwards, as applicable to the post. Experience certificates from previous employers/institutions. Valid Government-issued photo ID proof (Aadhaar Card/PAN Card/Passport/Voter ID/Driving Licence), as applicable. Certificates supporting any additional/higher qualifications (including computer/MS Office certification), if applicable. Community/category certificate and disability certificate, if applicable. Two recent passport-size photographs – one affixed/pasted on the application form and the other attached with it. A duly filled and signed application form, with all supporting documents arranged in the prescribed order.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be scrutinized by the Screening Committee, and eligible candidates will be called for an interview before the Selection Committee. If more than 20 eligible candidates apply, a written test may be conducted for shortlisting. Selection will be strictly on merit based on eligibility and performance in the selection process. Interview: 11th December 2026 (Tentative), 09:00 AM. Venue: Department of Orthopaedics, AIIMS Bibinagar, Telangana - 508126. Bring the original certificates/documents for verification, along with one set of self-attested photocopies. Failing to produce originals may lead to cancellation of candidature. The date, time, venue and other details of the skill test/interview will be communicated through the AIIMS Bibinagar website and/or the candidate's e-mail; shortlisted candidates may also be informed by email. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview/skill test or for joining the post.
